01 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE TITLE

An engineer’s curiosity. A leader’s perspective.

I’ve always believed the best technology leaders understand both the people building the system and the system itself.

My career has crossed software development, architecture, infrastructure, security, operations, and product delivery. That breadth taught me to look beyond the immediate technical problem—to the customer, the team, the risks, and the decisions that will still matter years from now.

After 28 years at Concord Technologies, I’m bringing that experience and the same hands-on curiosity to what comes next.
